title: Revocation issuance race
preconditions: the revocation has authentic applicable scope for the candidate
the issuer accepts the update before successor commitment in one branch; the relying party knows it before admission in another
a policy revocation dependency or issuer-authority update may be accepted between preliminary successor validation and relying-party installation
steps: accept an applicable revocation before successor commitment in the issuer branch and attempt commitment using only an earlier check
in a relying-party branch accept an applicable revocation or issuer policy or required-dependency update after preliminary validation but before installation
attempt installation without fencing final validation and owner installation against every accepted update
present an unexpired predecessor or successor after the applicable revocation is known at that protected decision
invariants: M1-015 V02: Known applicable revocation blocks an unexpired permit; an unrelated publisher/namespace target does not
M1-015 V06: Revocation between ordinary appraisal and issuance must be rechecked/fenced at issuance; after issuance it is checked at the relying party
M1-015 installation fence: every applicable issuer-authority policy revocation and required-dependency update accepted before installation participates in final validation
residual_risk: Not-yet-observed remote revocation remains bounded by trusted view age, time error and reevaluation; no zero-delay guarantee.
Specified attack requirement only; runtime implementation and proof remain deferred.
